title: Military Losses
intro: This page provides information about the military losses of Russia and Ukraine in the ongoing war.

military_losses_1.title: Kaggle : Equipment losses & Death Toll & Military Wounded & Prisoner of War of russians
military_losses_1.description: This dataset describes Equipment Losses & Death Toll & Military Wounded & Prisoner of War of russians in 2022 Ukraine russia War (hosted on kaggle).

military_losses_2.title: UA losses
military_losses_2.description: This website maintains a list of Ukrainian soldiers killed in the current war, on the basis of public reports of deaths.

military_losses_3.title: Russian Losses in Ukraine
military_losses_3.description: Daily-updated tracker of Russian personnel and equipment losses, from official reports of the Ministry of Defense of Ukraine.

military_losses_4.title: Russian Casualties in Ukraine
military_losses_4.description: Loss data from 02/24/2022, aggregated per day / week / month.

military_losses_5.title: Russo-Ukrainian Warspotting
military_losses_5.description: WarSpotting is a database of documented material losses during Russian invasion in Ukraine. We use photo evidences found accross open sources on the web such as social media as proofs.

military_losses_6.title: 200.zona.media
military_losses_6.description: is a collaborative, name-based database that lists confirmed Russian military personnel who have died during Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
